disease_name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae)
symptoms: Yellow to white lesions with wavy margins along leaf veins; leaves turn yellow and dry.
organic_remedy: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/kg); spray neem-based bioformulation.
chemical_remedy: Streptocycline 0.01% + Copper Oxychloride 0.3% spray at first sign.
regenerative_advice: Grow resistant varieties; avoid excess nitrogen; ensure good drainage.

symptoms: Long elliptical, straw-colored lesions that coalesce and dry the leaf.
organic_remedy: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/l) twice at 10-day intervals.
chemical_remedy: Spray Edifenphos 50% EC @ 1ml/l or Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/l.
regenerative_advice: Use certified seed; maintain field sanitation and balanced fertilization.

symptoms: Small oval brown spots with yellow halo; grain becomes chaffy and discolored.
organic_remedy: Foliar spray of neem oil 3% and Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/l).
chemical_remedy: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/l or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/l.
regenerative_advice: Apply potash and zinc; avoid water stress during tillering.

symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with grayish centers and brown margins on leaves and neck nodes.
organic_remedy: Foliar application of Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/liter).
chemical_remedy: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/liter of water at initial symptoms.
regenerative_advice: Maintain balanced nitrogen; avoid excess urea in humid weather.

symptoms: Small black sooty streaks and spots on leaf blades and sheaths.
organic_remedy: Spray neem oil 3% to check spread; remove infected debris.
chemical_remedy: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/l at disease appearance.
regenerative_advice: Avoid dense planting; improve aeration in the canopy.

symptoms: Yellow-orange discoloration with stunting; transmitted by green leafhoppers.
organic_remedy: Control vector with neem seed kernel extract 5% spray.
chemical_remedy: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/l to control leafhoppers.
regenerative_advice: Plant resistant varieties; rogue infected hills early.

symptoms: White parallel scrapped lines on leaves caused by adult feeding.
organic_remedy: Collect and destroy adults; release egg parasitoid Trichogramma.
chemical_remedy: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/l.
regenerative_advice: Avoid late transplanting; synchronize planting across fields.

symptoms: Greenish-grey water-soaked lesions on leaf sheaths that enlarge and girdle the stem.
organic_remedy: Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 2.5kg/ha in paddy field water.
chemical_remedy: Spray Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 2ml/l or Validamycin 3% L @ 2.5ml/l.
regenerative_advice: Reduce plant density; avoid excessive nitrogen; drain fields at booting.

symptoms: No visible disease symptoms; uniform green growth.
organic_remedy: No treatment needed. Continue integrated nutrient and pest management.
chemical_remedy: None needed.
regenerative_advice: Maintain balanced nutrition and monitor weekly.

symptoms: Small reddish-brown pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces.
organic_remedy: Spray neem oil 3% or sulfur-based botanical formulations.
chemical_remedy: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/l at pustule appearance.
regenerative_advice: Grow tolerant hybrids; avoid late sowing; rotate with legumes.

symptoms: Large cigar-shaped grey-green lesions running parallel to leaf veins.
organic_remedy: Foliar spray of Trichoderma viride and neem-based extracts.
chemical_remedy: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/l or Mancozeb @ 2.5g/l.
regenerative_advice: Rotate crops; remove crop residue; plant resistant hybrids.

symptoms: Rectangular tan to gray lesions delimited by leaf veins.
organic_remedy: Spray neem-based fungicide; improve soil organic matter.
chemical_remedy: Spray Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/l or Tebuconazole @ 1ml/l.
regenerative_advice: Rotate away from maize for 1-2 seasons; manage residue.

symptoms: No visible symptoms; healthy green foliage.
organic_remedy: No treatment needed. Follow standard agronomy.
chemical_remedy: None needed.
regenerative_advice: Monitor fields; maintain soil fertility.

symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves and green fruits.
organic_remedy: Spray copper-oxylate or Bordeaux mixture weekly.
chemical_remedy: Spray Streptocycline 0.01% + Copper Oxychloride 0.3%.
regenerative_advice: Use disease-free seed; avoid overhead irrigation.

symptoms: Brown concentric ring spots with yellow halo on older leaves.
organic_remedy: Spray neem oil 3% and Trichoderma-based biofungicide.
chemical_remedy: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/l or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/l.
regenerative_advice: Mulch soil; rotate with non-solanaceous crops; stake plants.

symptoms: Dark greasy lesions on leaves and stems; white mold under humid leaves; fruit rot.
organic_remedy: Spray Bordeaux mixture 1% or Pseudomonas fluorescens.
chemical_remedy: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 72% WP @ 2.5g/l immediately.
regenerative_advice: Remove infected plants; avoid dense canopy; improve drainage.

symptoms: Pale yellow spots that turn brown with olive mold on the underside of leaves.
organic_remedy: Improve ventilation; spray neem oil formulation.
chemical_remedy: Spray Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 2ml/l or Copper Oxychloride 0.3%.
regenerative_advice: Reduce humidity; avoid overhead watering in polyhouses.

symptoms: Small circular spots with gray centers and dark borders on lower leaves.
organic_remedy: Remove infected lower leaves; spray copper-based organics.
chemical_remedy: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/l every 7-10 days.
regenerative_advice: Rotate crops; stake and prune for airflow.

symptoms: Fine webbing, yellow stippling and bronzing of leaves.
organic_remedy: Release predatory mites; spray neem oil 2% or garlic extract.
chemical_remedy: Spray Fenazaquin 10% EC @ 2ml/l or Abamectin 1.9% EC @ 0.5ml/l.
regenerative_advice: Avoid moisture stress; maintain natural enemies.

symptoms: Small brown spots that enlarge into concentric target-like rings.
organic_remedy: Spray Trichoderma-based biofungicide.
chemical_remedy: Spray Mancozeb 2.5g/l or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/l.
regenerative_advice: Improve field hygiene; rotate with non-host crops.

symptoms: Leaf curling, yellowing, stunted plants; transmitted by whiteflies.
organic_remedy: Control whitefly with yellow sticky traps and neem seed kernel extract 5%.
chemical_remedy: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/l against whitefly vectors.
regenerative_advice: Use resistant hybrids; rogue infected plants immediately.

symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic on leaves; leaf distortion.
organic_remedy: Remove infected plants; control aphids; sanitize hands/tools with milk.
chemical_remedy: No direct cure - manage aphid vectors with Imidacloprid spray.
regenerative_advice: Use virus-free seed; rotate with non-solanaceous crops.

symptoms: No visible symptoms; vigorous growth.
organic_remedy: No treatment needed.
chemical_remedy: None needed.
regenerative_advice: Maintain good canopy management and nutrition.

symptoms: Dark brown angular spots with concentric rings on older leaves.
organic_remedy: Spray neem oil 3% and Trichoderma formulation.
chemical_remedy: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/l at first symptom.
regenerative_advice: Rotate with cereals; avoid excess nitrogen; hill soil well.

symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions; white fungal ring under wet leaves; tuber rot.
organic_remedy: Spray Bordeaux mixture 1% or Pseudomonas fluorescens.
chemical_remedy: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 72% WP @ 2.5g/l; repeat weekly.
regenerative_advice: Destroy infected haulms; store tubers dry; use certified seed.

symptoms: No visible symptoms; healthy foliage.
organic_remedy: No treatment needed.
chemical_remedy: None needed.
regenerative_advice: Follow standard crop management.

symptoms: Upward/downward curling of leaves with vein thickening; stunted growth.
organic_remedy: Control whitefly with yellow sticky traps and neem seed kernel extract 5%.
chemical_remedy: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/l to manage whitefly vectors.
regenerative_advice: Plant border rows of maize/sorghum to block whitefly migration.

symptoms: Angular water-soaked lesions on leaves; black arm on stems and bolls.
organic_remedy: Acid-delint seed; spray copper oxychloride 0.3%.
chemical_remedy: Spray Streptocycline 0.01% + Copper Oxychloride 0.3%.
regenerative_advice: Use certified delinted seed; rotate with non-host crops.

symptoms: Sudden wilting, yellowing and browning of leaves; vascular discoloration.
organic_remedy: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride (4g/kg); soil application of neem cake.
chemical_remedy: Drench Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/l around the root zone.
regenerative_advice: Grow resistant varieties; long rotation; improve drainage.

symptoms: No visible symptoms; healthy growth.
organic_remedy: No treatment needed.
chemical_remedy: None needed.
regenerative_advice: Monitor for sucking pests and maintain nutrition.
